episode_title: Trump's Post-Midterm Changes, Lame-Duck Congress, Nvidia Huang Investigation
script_en: Trump's Post-Midterm Changes, Lame-Duck Congress, Nvidia Huang Investigation.
President Trump says his immigration crackdown may have gone too far even as he elevates Stephen Miller, one of its chief architects, to run the White House after Republicans lost Congress.

Republicans are returning to Washington for a lame-duck session with a shrinking House majority and a short list of priorities, including funding the government, passing military spending and confirming Trump nominees.

Nvidia is investigating reports that CEO Jensen Huang had an affair with a woman suspected of ties to Chinese intelligence, raising new questions about one of the most important companies in the U.S.-China technology race.
